name: smwgraphics-gokujou-parodius-snes-traffic-signs-rock-wall
title: Gokujou Parodius (SNES) - Traffic Signs (Rock Wall)
description:
A very realistic looking wall made of rocks, from Gokujou Parodius. Can be used for caverns, in general. If you think the graphic is too bright, you can use Dark Mode (Level Mode 0C). For a graphic that is detailed, it has a set pattern and only uses 10 colors.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
